text:
maya: Heads up — CloudHub marketplace launch next Wed. Need partner support lifeline: shared channel + oncall + war room play.
sam: Agree. Proposal: create #partners-cloudhub-shared, invite CloudHub_SI, set a 24/7 oncall rota for first 72h. @alan_partners ok?
alan_partners: Yep. SI can join shared channel. They want a single point of contact for SEVs. Suggest 'partner-sev-owner' rota from our side.
lia: Quick note: our SEV severity mapping with partners — we have SEV1 = app-down, SEV2 = degraded perf, SEV3 = config/questions. Need consensus.
evan: I can own SEV1 paging for first 48h and handoff to eng-sre if persists. I'll add to rotation.
maya: Nice. Can someone create the channel and set retention to 90 days? Also add the runbook link.
opsbot: Channel created: #partners-cloudhub-shared — invites sent to CloudHub_SI, NimbleSI. Retention set to 90 days. warroom created: https://redwood/warrooms/1719873210
sam: Perfect. Runbook: https://docs.redwood/partnerships/cloudhub-sev-runbook — key steps: triangulate logs, snapshot model version, fallback routing to small-model-2. See snippet: `curl -X POST /v1/fallback -d '{"model":"small-model-2"}'`
alan_partners: :thumbsup: We'll set up a phone bridge for SEV1s. Add our oncall list: alan, nina, raj.
lia: Can we schedule a 30m dry run today 3pm PT? Want to exercise cross-org comms and channel signals.
evan: I'm in. @maya please confirm.
maya: Confirmed. Dry run 3pm PT. Also add step to handover to Dedicated team after 72h if still open.
sam: :white_check_mark: noted. I'll post a checklist in the channel and pin it. Anyone want to be the triage owner for the dry run?
alan_partners: I'll triage the dry run. Send me contact cards for systems team.
